title: has potential but seriously... stickers for 6 of the days.  It's lacking in 'wow' factor
text:
has potential but seriously... stickers for 6 of the days. It's lacking in 'wow' factor. since it's not December yet my son hasn't gotten the chance to start opening the doors for each day but I did open the side of the box so I could slide out the cardboard holder and see everything inside. First off, the cars are great! They're everything I'd expect from Hot Wheels. The accessories are kind of cheap and some of them I have no clue what they even are, but I'm sure my son would figure it out so that's not an issue. What I was disappointed with was the stickers.... what a huge bummer to open a day in the advent calendar and see nothing more than a cheap, cheesy, little sticker. As a parent I don't want stickers all over everything in my home, and as a kid I wouldn't be thrilled with opening the door expecting something cool and seeing the sticker.

We normally buy the Lego Advent Calendars every year and my son loves them. Yes they're a bit more expensive but there's something interesting every single day (even if it is just an accessory for the item that was opened the day before) so in comparison to the Lego product I'd say Hot Wheels has a long way to go - but if you're kid likes Hot Wheels and little stickers than here you go.
